nodes.name: create_sprint10_issues.sh
nodes.summary: Zsh automation that creates the Sprint 10 (Wind to AEP to EPC Integration) GitHub issues and their colour-coded labels in the current repo via the gh CLI. Defines reusable helpers to ensure labels exist before opening each milestone-tagged issue.

nodes.name: create_issue
nodes.summary: Helper that splits a comma-separated label list, ensures every label exists, and opens a GitHub issue with the given title, body, labels, and the Sprint 10 milestone via gh issue create.

nodes.name: create_v14_analytics_issues.sh
nodes.summary: Bash script that bulk-creates the v14 Analytics and Executive Report Upgrade GitHub issues (scenario_name propagation, loss/Monte-Carlo/sensitivity analytics, exports) against a named milestone using inline heredoc issue bodies and the gh CLI.

nodes.name: setup_github_auth_https.sh
nodes.summary: Small bash helper that configures git to use the macOS Keychain credential helper and stores a GitHub username plus Personal Access Token for HTTPS authentication, prompting the developer interactively.
